name: Add a cellular tablet line
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: older gentleman, slow typist.
scripted_messages: Good afternoon. I would like to add an iPad with cellular service to my account for travel. I understand a tablet line is $20.99 a month. Is there any discount on it with my phone plan, which is Premium 2.0?
Thank you. Is the 50 percent discount for one tablet per phone line?
What would the monthly cost for the tablet line come to after the discount?
That is very reasonable. Thank you for your patience with me, you were very kind.
No, that is all. Have a good day, goodbye.
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 6: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
